basics.name: Sathya Narayana Bhat
basics.label: Observability & Detection Engineer
basics.summary: Engineer with 4+ years building telemetry, detection, and incident response systems across AWS and GCP. Instrumented Java and Python services with OpenTelemetry and operated the Grafana LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir) for unified metrics, logs, and traces. Built and tuned detection rules across multi-cloud SIEM platforms (Wazuh, Google Security Operations), cutting alert false positives by ~30%, and authored incident response runbooks with root cause analysis feeding back into detection improvements. Owned Kubernetes, GitOps (ArgoCD, Helm), CI/CD, and AWS cost (~25-30% reduction). Python and Ruby automation for detection, scanning, and operational tooling. A security background brings careful handling of sensitive data, safe-rollout discipline, and experience setting standards other teams adopt.

work.name: Indsys holdings
work.position: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer - DevSecOps & Cloud Security
work.summary: As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer at Indsys holdings, I led observability, platform operations, and infrastructure automation across on-premise and cloud environments - owning telemetry, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud cost while embedding security into the delivery lifecycle.
highlights: Led the observability rollout: instrumented Java and Python applications with OpenTelemetry and deployed the Grafana LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir), delivering unified metrics, logs, and traces across services.
Architected and implemented CI/CD pipelines for monolithic and microservice applications, streamlining deployment workflows and reducing release cycle time.

Architected and operated a proof-of-concept multi-tenant ERPNext platform on a self-managed Kubernetes cluster, achieving per-tenant compute and storage isolation using ArgoCD ApplicationSets and Helm for GitOps-driven tenant onboarding.
Managed and optimized AWS cloud infrastructure for company services, achieving ~25-30% cost reduction through resource rightsizing, reserved instances, and usage audits.
Designed and implemented network firewall rules and segmentation policies for on-premises infrastructure, controlling internal access paths.
Performed end-to-end Network VAPT for clients, from reconnaissance through risk-rated remediation reporting.

work.name: IDfy
work.position: Senior Information Security Engineer - DevSecOps & Cloud Security
work.summary: As a Senior Information Security Engineer at IDfy, I scaled SIEM coverage, tuned edge detections, and drove automation across CI/CD and multi-cloud infrastructure, while setting the team's standard for AI/LLM security reviews.
highlights: Reduced false positives in Google Cloud Armor (WAF) alerts by ~30% through detection tuning and signature refinement, improving alert signal for responding teams.
Enhanced multi-cloud SIEM with automated asset onboarding, reducing manual provisioning effort and closing detection coverage gaps.

Investigated alerts and ran proactive threat hunts in Google Security Operations (Chronicle) using UDM search across GCP and Cloud Armor telemetry, feeding findings into detection tuning and incident response.
Implemented a CI compliance scanner running across all company repositories, surfacing policy drift early in the SDLC.

Defined and standardized an internal AI security framework - assessment triggers, threat models, and adversarial testing protocols for LLM-integrated features - adopted for reviews across internal and client-facing applications; led hands-on testing aligned with OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
Supported SOC 2 Type 2 audit by providing evidence for SIEM, vulnerability management, and incident response controls.
Implemented network-layer geo-fencing across company services, reducing inbound attack surface from out-of-scope regions.

work.name: IDfy
work.summary: As an Information Security Engineer at IDfy, I built and operated the organization's core detection and response platforms - centralized SIEM, incident response, and vulnerability management - while mentoring analysts and partnering with engineering teams.
highlights: Built and operated a centralized multi-cloud Wazuh SIEM across AWS and GCP, tuning detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, with file integrity monitoring, configuration assessment, and automated active response.
Investigated and responded to escalated incidents, leading root cause analysis and implementing corrective measures, including detection and process improvements, to prevent recurrence.
Authored incident response runbooks for WAF and SIEM events, standardizing triage and escalation.
Piloted SOAR workflows (Shuffle, Windmill.dev) to automate incident response tasks and reduce manual toil.
Reviewed Ruby application code for security issues and built Ruby automations for security scanning, alongside Python tooling that automated routine operational and detection tasks.
Trained and mentored L1 SOC analysts on triage and escalation, enabling them to handle critical incidents with speed and precision.
Performed VAPT on 20+ applications and across company assets, reducing high/critical severity findings by 75-80%.
Partnered with development teams on secure coding practices and adherence to security standards.

projects.name: Personal Homelab - K3s Cluster
highlights: Self-hosted production-grade K3s cluster running media, automation, and LLM services with GitOps-driven continuous deployment via ArgoCD.
Full infrastructure-as-code discipline: all service configurations version-controlled and reconciled automatically via ArgoCD.
Designed cluster networking and ingress with Cloudflare Tunnels for zero-trust external access, eliminating public port exposure.

Implemented split-horizon DNS with AdGuard Home so every service is reachable under a single domain - resolving directly to internal ingress on the home network and through Cloudflare Tunnels when remote.
Managed persistent storage and volume provisioning for stateful workloads.
Deployed and operated self-hosted LLMs (Gemma 4B, Bonsai-4B on Ollama) as an automation backbone integrated with homelab services.
Tech Stack: K3s, ArgoCD, Cloudflare Tunnels, AdGuard Home, Helm/Kustomize, Ollama

projects.name: Automated Resume Pipeline
highlights: Designed a GitHub Actions pipeline that renders a JSON-sourced resume to PDF on every commit, with dependency caching, schema validation, HTML-to-PDF conversion, and versioned GitHub Release publication.
Tech Stack: GitHub Actions, Node.js, jsonresume, HTML/CSS

projects.name: Vaultify
highlights: Built a Python CLI secret manager for an IDfy hackathon that injects secrets into environment variables during local development without Docker or cloud KMS; secrets stored only encrypted and the master key never written to disk.
Tech Stack: Python, Redis, Flask
